title: Billed as a “reading” this new play really surprised me! #JesseEisenb...
transcript: I got tired of waiting for now you 3 me, so I went and saw Jesse Eisenberg in a play instead. The show is called The Ziggurat Files. It is written and performed by Jesse Eisenberg, and it's actually quite unconventional for a few different reasons. First is that it is only playing on Monday nights at Studio C View. This is the theater that normally houses Prince F, but they do not have a show on Monday nights. So on their day off, Jesse Azubrook comes in and does a play. That also means it is being done on the set of Prince F. They do bring in a few furniture items to build out the set of this particular play, but they are very much working within the constraints of the Prince F set. It's also being billed as a reading, meaning that he has a script on stage with him the whole time. I wasn't really sure how this would read from an audience perspective, but I will say I didn't feel disconnected from the performance at all. Jesse clearly knows the material well enough that he's still able to give an actual performance. In fact, I was really impressed by him. He gives a really charming and heartfelt performance. And while it doesn't seem like this play has any further ambitions outside of this very limited Broadway run, I would actually love to see him do more stage work, both as a writer and actor, because I was equally impressed with both. I don't want to tell you too much about what this show is about, as I really enjoyed the experience of going in completely blind, but I will say it is told through a series of voice memos that Jesse Eisenberg character is leaving for his therapist as he talks through some of the issues that he's been having connecting with his Newborn son. Does not, however, have anything to do with the Zigfeld Follies. Which is what I thought going in, but I still really enjoyed it nonetheless. The show is basically sold out I believe. I was able to get in through the today Tix digital rush, so I got tickets on the morning of for only $45. They are build as standing room, however. I ended up getting a seat and everyone else that I know that has done it has also ended up with a seat. So something to consider. But you only have a few more Mondays left to catch this.
